test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_tags (id UInt64, tags Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_hex (id UInt64, f Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_256 (id UInt64, s Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_512 (id UInt64, s Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_has_any_tags SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> concat('tag', toString(toUInt32(floor(pow(200000, (cityHash64(number, x) % 1000000) / 1000000.0))))), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_any_hex SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> lower(hex(MD5(toString(cityHash64(number, x))))), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_any_256 SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> repeat(leftPad(hex(cityHash64(number, x)), 16, '0'), 16), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(500000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_any_512 SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> repeat(leftPad(hex(cityHash64(number, x)), 16, '0'), 32), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(250000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(id) FROM perf_has_any_tags WHERE hasAny(tags, ['tag21598', 'tag90001', 'tag31337', 'tag77777'])

SELECT count(), sum(id) FROM perf_has_any_hex WHERE hasAny(f, ['de18f0124d408ef2c603b9aff9d2af26', '85928bba4273dcab6da30ce739f0e795', '42059e385ea7750cbd9d9da014c47002', '28f384c14e68d2337c8a25c152389935'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_any_256 WHERE hasAny(s, (SELECT groupArray(concat('n', leftPad(toString(number), 3, '0'), repeat('q', 252))) FROM numbers(32))) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM perf_has_any_512 WHERE hasAny(s, (SELECT groupArray(concat('n', toString(number), repeat('q', 510))) FROM numbers(4))) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM numbers(5000000) WHERE hasAny([toString(number * 0)], arrayMap(x -> toString(x), range(1000))) SETTINGS max_block_size = 128, max_threads = 1

SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE hasAny([toString(number * 0)], (SELECT arrayPushBack(groupArray(toString(number)), repeat('z', 300)) FROM numbers(245))) SETTINGS max_block_size = 1024, max_threads = 1
